Ego Marquardus dictus Metlyn tenore presencium publice recognosco, quod omne jus, quod hactenus vna cum heredibus meis in villa Bukauxs habui, quam a nobili domina Anna de Lypa cum om nibus suis pertinenciis iusto empciouis tytulo comparaui, prout in littera super hoc coufecta plenius coutinetur, idem ius in religiosos viros dominos abbatem et conuentum monasterii Altiuadensis pre sentibus transfero et transfundo pretacto juri cum heredibus meis penitus renuncians el omnino. In cuius rei robur et euidens testi moniiim sigillum meum presentibus est appensum et in testimonium lucidius sigilla dominorum meorum nobilium Petri et Johannis de Rosenberg necnon famosorum clientum Nicolai de Malotyn Nicolay de Rzebnowytz presentibus sunt appensa. Datum anno domini mil- lesimo trecentesimo septuagesimo septimo die assumpcionis beate Marie virginis gloriose. entries.english: I, Marquard called Metlyn, publicly acknowledge by this charter that I transfer and convey to the religious lords, the abbot and convent of Hohenfurt, all rights that I have held up to now together with my heirs in the village of Bukauxs, which I lawfully purchased from the noble Lady Anna de Lipa with all its appurtenances, as is more fully set out in the charter drawn up concerning this. I wholly and entirely renounce that right, together with my heirs. To make this effective and provide clear proof, my seal is attached, and as further testimony the seals of my noble lords Peter and Hans von Rosenberg and of the distinguished retainers Nicolaus von Malotyn and Nicolaus von Rzebnowytz are attached. Given in 1377 on the feast of the glorious Virgin Mary’s Assumption. Four small seals hang from parchment strips: seals a and d are in white wax, b and c in red wax. Seal a bears a helmet with a female figure as its crest and, at the right, perhaps a tree; the inscription is partly unclear. Seals b and c are the familiar small seals of Peter and Hans von Rosenberg. Seal d bears a helmet with an indistinct human figure as its crest. The seal of the Rzebnowitz man is missing.
